summary: New asks reject recommendation prose in answer labels; use the native recommendation field instead.

replay.detail: Stored asks remain readable and answerable without revalidating historical labels.

schema.detail: No schema, code generation or UI changes.

rules.detail: Shared creation validation rejects any case-insensitive word beginning recommend in answer labels, even when a native recommendation is present. Other request text is unaffected.

compatibility.detail: Producers must put preferences only in request.recommendation with an answer id and reason. The error points to fractal work ask --request and its help.

recovery.detail: Historical request and answer labels are preserved without stripping or inference.
